thread.title: Apple introduces new MacBook Air with retina display starting at $1,199 - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Apple introduces new MacBook Air with retina display starting at $1,199 - MarketWatch
text:
Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.36% on Tuesday introduced a new MacBook Air with retina display at an event in Brooklyn, N.Y. The device has a 13.3-inch screen with limited bezels, and it has four times the resolution of the prior model, with over 4 million pixels. The keyboard has a back-lit "butterfly" keyboard with TouchID fingerprint recognition built in. It features a Force Touch trackpad with 20% more area than on its predecessor. Apple said the new Air has all-day battery life, or 13 hours of iTunes playback. The device weighs 2.75 pounds and is 15-millimeters thin. Apple announced that the Air is now made with 100% recycled aluminum. It will start at $1,199. Preorders start today, and the device will be available on Nov. 7. Shares are up 0.7% in Tuesday trading. The stock has gained 28% over the past 12 months, while the Dow DJIA, +0.75% has gained 5.6%.
